DECLARE @DATETOPROCESS DATE
SET @DATETOPROCESS  = '2024-01-08';

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST_SELECT_SRC
(
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NAME,
                BASE_STATUS,
                CUST_NO,
                LAST6_CUST_NO,
                NO_HLDRS,
                HOLD_PATTERN,
                SIGN_COND,
                HHLD_NO,
                RM_ID,
                RES_STATUS,
                CUST_STATUS,
                REFERENCE_CCY,
                PHONE_FAX_INDEMINITY,
                DOMICILE,
                REMARKS,
                STATUS,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                SERVICE_UNIT,
                CIF_NO,
                CLOSURE_REMARKS,
                REJECT_REASON,
                OPEN_DT,
                CLOSE_DT,
                FNA_ID,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                RISK_PROFILE_DESC,
                FNA_EXPIRY_DATE,
                CLOSURE_REASON,
                QI_FLAG,
                FP_FLAG,
                EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER,
                OTHER_CD1,
                OTHER_CD2,
                OTHER_CD3,
                CHNG_COUNT,
                RELIEF_METHOD,
                KYC_APPLICABLE,
                KYC_APP_DT,
                KYC_REASON,
                KYC_NXT_REV_DT,
                KYC_DOC_PATH,
                KYC_REF_NO,
                VERSION,
                RM_ID_2,
                NUMBERED_ACCOUNT,
                RISK_RATING,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NAME,
                BASE_STATUS,
                CUST_NO,
                LAST6_CUST_NO,
                NO_HLDRS,
                HOLD_PATTERN,
                SIGN_COND,
                HHLD_NO,
                RM_ID,
                RES_STATUS,
                CUST_STATUS,
                REFERENCE_CCY,
                PHONE_FAX_INDEMINITY,
                DOMICILE,
                REMARKS,
                STATUS,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                SERVICE_UNIT,
                CIF_NO,
                CLOSURE_REMARKS,
                REJECT_REASON,
                OPEN_DT,
                CLOSE_DT,
                FNA_ID,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                RISK_PROFILE_DESC,
                FNA_EXPIRY_DATE,
                CLOSURE_REASON,
                QI_FLAG,
                FP_FLAG,
                EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER,
                OTHER_CD1,
                OTHER_CD2,
                OTHER_CD3,
                CHNG_COUNT,
                RELIEF_METHOD,
                KYC_APPLICABLE,
                KYC_APP_DT,
                KYC_REASON,
                KYC_NXT_REV_DT,
                KYC_DOC_PATH,
                KYC_REF_NO,
                VERSION,
                RM_ID_2,
                NUMBERED_ACCOUNT,
                RISK_RATING,
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST_SELECT_SRC
(
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NAME,
                BASE_STATUS,
                CUST_NO,
                LAST6_CUST_NO,
                NO_HLDRS,
                HOLD_PATTERN,
                SIGN_COND,
                HHLD_NO,
                RM_ID,
                RES_STATUS,
                CUST_STATUS,
                REFERENCE_CCY,
                PHONE_FAX_INDEMINITY,
                DOMICILE,
                REMARKS,
                STATUS,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                SERVICE_UNIT,
                CIF_NO,
                CLOSURE_REMARKS,
                REJECT_REASON,
                OPEN_DT,
                CLOSE_DT,
                FNA_ID,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                RISK_PROFILE_DESC,
                FNA_EXPIRY_DATE,
                CLOSURE_REASON,
                QI_FLAG,
                FP_FLAG,
                EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER,
                OTHER_CD1,
                OTHER_CD2,
                OTHER_CD3,
                CHNG_COUNT,
                RELIEF_METHOD,
                KYC_APPLICABLE,
                KYC_APP_DT,
                KYC_REASON,
                KYC_NXT_REV_DT,
                KYC_DOC_PATH,
                KYC_REF_NO,
                VERSION,
                RM_ID_2,
                NUMBERED_ACCOUNT,
                RISK_RATING,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.BR_CD,
                CC.SUB_BR_CD,
                CC.BASE_NAME,
                CC.BASE_STATUS,
                CC.CUST_NO,
                CC.LAST6_CUST_NO,
                CC.NO_HLDRS,
                CC.HOLD_PATTERN,
                CC.SIGN_COND,
                CC.HHLD_NO,
                CC.RM_ID,
                CC.RES_STATUS,
                CC.CUST_STATUS,
                CC.REFERENCE_CCY,
                CC.PHONE_FAX_INDEMINITY,
                CC.DOMICILE,
                CC.REMARKS,
                CC.STATUS,
                CC.MAKER_ID,
                CC.MAKER_DATE,
                CC.AUTH_ID,
                CC.AUTH_DATE,
                CC.SERVICE_UNIT,
                CC.CIF_NO,
                CC.CLOSURE_REMARKS,
                CC.REJECT_REASON,
                CC.OPEN_DT,
                CC.CLOSE_DT,
                CC.FNA_ID,
                CC.RISK_PROFILE,
                CC.RISK_PROFILE_DESC,
                CC.FNA_EXPIRY_DATE,
                CC.CLOSURE_REASON,
                CC.QI_FLAG,
                CC.FP_FLAG,
                CC.EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER,
                CC.OTHER_CD1,
                CC.OTHER_CD2,
                CC.OTHER_CD3,
                CC.CHNG_COUNT,
                CC.RELIEF_METHOD,
                CC.KYC_APPLICABLE,
                CC.KYC_APP_DT,
                CC.KYC_REASON,
                CC.KYC_NXT_REV_DT,
                CC.KYC_DOC_PATH,
                CC.KYC_REF_NO,
                CC.VERSION,
                CC.RM_ID_2,
                CC.NUMBERED_ACCOUNT,
                CC.RISK_RATING,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.TRU_BASEMST CC
            JOIN [d360].[STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST] B
            ON CC.CUST_NO  = B.CUST_NO 
            AND CC.CIF_NO  = B.CIF_NO 
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';



TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST_GROUP_SRC
(
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NAME,
                BASE_STATUS,
                CUST_NO,
                LAST6_CUST_NO,
                NO_HLDRS,
                HOLD_PATTERN,
                SIGN_COND,
                HHLD_NO,
                RM_ID,
                RES_STATUS,
                CUST_STATUS,
                REFERENCE_CCY,
                PHONE_FAX_INDEMINITY,
                DOMICILE,
                REMARKS,
                STATUS,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                SERVICE_UNIT,
                CIF_NO,
                CLOSURE_REMARKS,
                REJECT_REASON,
                OPEN_DT,
                CLOSE_DT,
                FNA_ID,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                RISK_PROFILE_DESC,
                FNA_EXPIRY_DATE,
                CLOSURE_REASON,
                QI_FLAG,
                FP_FLAG,
                EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER,
                OTHER_CD1,
                OTHER_CD2,
                OTHER_CD3,
                CHNG_COUNT,
                RELIEF_METHOD,
                KYC_APPLICABLE,
                KYC_APP_DT,
                KYC_REASON,
                KYC_NXT_REV_DT,
                KYC_DOC_PATH,
                KYC_REF_NO,
                VERSION,
                RM_ID_2,
                NUMBERED_ACCOUNT,
                RISK_RATING,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NAME,
                BASE_STATUS,
                CUST_NO,
                LAST6_CUST_NO,
                NO_HLDRS,
                HOLD_PATTERN,
                SIGN_COND,
                HHLD_NO,
                RM_ID,
                RES_STATUS,
                CUST_STATUS,
                REFERENCE_CCY,
                PHONE_FAX_INDEMINITY,
                DOMICILE,
                REMARKS,
                STATUS,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                SERVICE_UNIT,
                CIF_NO,
                CLOSURE_REMARKS,
                REJECT_REASON,
                OPEN_DT,
                CLOSE_DT,
                FNA_ID,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                RISK_PROFILE_DESC,
                FNA_EXPIRY_DATE,
                CLOSURE_REASON,
                QI_FLAG,
                FP_FLAG,
                EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER,
                OTHER_CD1,
                OTHER_CD2,
                OTHER_CD3,
                CHNG_COUNT,
                RELIEF_METHOD,
                KYC_APPLICABLE,
                KYC_APP_DT,
                KYC_REASON,
                KYC_NXT_REV_DT,
                KYC_DOC_PATH,
                KYC_REF_NO,
                VERSION,
                RM_ID_2,
                NUMBERED_ACCOUNT,
                RISK_RATING,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NAME,
                BASE_STATUS,
                CUST_NO,
                LAST6_CUST_NO,
                NO_HLDRS,
                HOLD_PATTERN,
                SIGN_COND,
                HHLD_NO,
                RM_ID,
                RES_STATUS,
                CUST_STATUS,
                REFERENCE_CCY,
                PHONE_FAX_INDEMINITY,
                DOMICILE,
                REMARKS,
                STATUS,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                SERVICE_UNIT,
                CIF_NO,
                CLOSURE_REMARKS,
                REJECT_REASON,
                OPEN_DT,
                CLOSE_DT,
                FNA_ID,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                RISK_PROFILE_DESC,
                FNA_EXPIRY_DATE,
                CLOSURE_REASON,
                QI_FLAG,
                FP_FLAG,
                EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER,
                OTHER_CD1,
                OTHER_CD2,
                OTHER_CD3,
                CHNG_COUNT,
                RELIEF_METHOD,
                KYC_APPLICABLE,
                KYC_APP_DT,
                KYC_REASON,
                KYC_NXT_REV_DT,
                KYC_DOC_PATH,
                KYC_REF_NO,
                VERSION,
                RM_ID_2,
                NUMBERED_ACCOUNT,
                RISK_RATING,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NAME,
                BASE_STATUS,
                CUST_NO,
                LAST6_CUST_NO,
                NO_HLDRS,
                HOLD_PATTERN,
                SIGN_COND,
                HHLD_NO,
                RM_ID,
                RES_STATUS,
                CUST_STATUS,
                REFERENCE_CCY,
                PHONE_FAX_INDEMINITY,
                DOMICILE,
                REMARKS,
                STATUS,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                SERVICE_UNIT,
                CIF_NO,
                CLOSURE_REMARKS,
                REJECT_REASON,
                OPEN_DT,
                CLOSE_DT,
                FNA_ID,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                RISK_PROFILE_DESC,
                FNA_EXPIRY_DATE,
                CLOSURE_REASON,
                QI_FLAG,
                FP_FLAG,
                EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER,
                OTHER_CD1,
                OTHER_CD2,
                OTHER_CD3,
                CHNG_COUNT,
                RELIEF_METHOD,
                KYC_APPLICABLE,
                KYC_APP_DT,
                KYC_REASON,
                KYC_NXT_REV_DT,
                KYC_DOC_PATH,
                KYC_REF_NO,
                VERSION,
                RM_ID_2,
                NUMBERED_ACCOUNT,
                RISK_RATING
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @DATETOPROCESS;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.TRU_BASEMST A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.CUST_NO,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CUST_NO,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.CIF_NO,'-1') = COALESCE(B.CIF_NO,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1

INSERT INTO EDS.TRU_BASEMST
(
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NAME,
                BASE_STATUS,
                CUST_NO,
                LAST6_CUST_NO,
                NO_HLDRS,
                HOLD_PATTERN,
                SIGN_COND,
                HHLD_NO,
                RM_ID,
                RES_STATUS,
                CUST_STATUS,
                REFERENCE_CCY,
                PHONE_FAX_INDEMINITY,
                DOMICILE,
                REMARKS,
                STATUS,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                SERVICE_UNIT,
                CIF_NO,
                CLOSURE_REMARKS,
                REJECT_REASON,
                OPEN_DT,
                CLOSE_DT,
                FNA_ID,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                RISK_PROFILE_DESC,
                FNA_EXPIRY_DATE,
                CLOSURE_REASON,
                QI_FLAG,
                FP_FLAG,
                EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER,
                OTHER_CD1,
                OTHER_CD2,
                OTHER_CD3,
                CHNG_COUNT,
                RELIEF_METHOD,
                KYC_APPLICABLE,
                KYC_APP_DT,
                KYC_REASON,
                KYC_NXT_REV_DT,
                KYC_DOC_PATH,
                KYC_REF_NO,
                VERSION,
                RM_ID_2,
                NUMBERED_ACCOUNT,
                RISK_RATING,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                SRC.BR_CD,
                SRC.SUB_BR_CD,
                SRC.BASE_NAME,
                SRC.BASE_STATUS,
                SRC.CUST_NO,
                SRC.LAST6_CUST_NO,
                SRC.NO_HLDRS,
                SRC.HOLD_PATTERN,
                SRC.SIGN_COND,
                SRC.HHLD_NO,
                SRC.RM_ID,
                SRC.RES_STATUS,
                SRC.CUST_STATUS,
                SRC.REFERENCE_CCY,
                SRC.PHONE_FAX_INDEMINITY,
                SRC.DOMICILE,
                SRC.REMARKS,
                SRC.STATUS,
                SRC.MAKER_ID,
                SRC.MAKER_DATE,
                SRC.AUTH_ID,
                SRC.AUTH_DATE,
                SRC.SERVICE_UNIT,
                SRC.CIF_NO,
                SRC.CLOSURE_REMARKS,
                SRC.REJECT_REASON,
                SRC.OPEN_DT,
                SRC.CLOSE_DT,
                SRC.FNA_ID,
                SRC.RISK_PROFILE,
                SRC.RISK_PROFILE_DESC,
                SRC.FNA_EXPIRY_DATE,
                SRC.CLOSURE_REASON,
                SRC.QI_FLAG,
                SRC.FP_FLAG,
                SRC.EXTERNAL_IDENTIFIER,
                SRC.OTHER_CD1,
                SRC.OTHER_CD2,
                SRC.OTHER_CD3,
                SRC.CHNG_COUNT,
                SRC.RELIEF_METHOD,
                SRC.KYC_APPLICABLE,
                SRC.KYC_APP_DT,
                SRC.KYC_REASON,
                SRC.KYC_NXT_REV_DT,
                SRC.KYC_DOC_PATH,
                SRC.KYC_REF_NO,
                SRC.VERSION,
                SRC.RM_ID_2,
                SRC.NUMBERED_ACCOUNT,
                SRC.RISK_RATING,
				@DATETOPROCESS,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5),
				'TRU',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_BASEMST_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
